name: File Intake
_setup_notes: Import this file into n8n via Settings → Import workflow.
This workflow is triggered by apps/file-watcher/watcher.py via N8N_WEBHOOK_URL.
Required nodes to configure after import:
1. Webhook — POST /webhook/file-intake; receives file metadata from watcher.py
2. Read Binary File — read the file from the path in the webhook payload
3. Extract text — OCR for images, PDF text extraction, plain read for text files
4. HTTP Request (LiteLLM) — POST to http://litellm:4000/chat/completions, model=assistant-small
5. Loop Over Items — iterate over the returned task array
6. IF node — branch on approval_required flag
7. Wait node — approval gate for flagged documents
8. Todoist Create Task — set credentials from TODOIST_API_TOKEN
9. Move File — move to sync/processed/ on success, sync/rejected/ on failure
10. SQLite Insert — write audit row to db/assistant.db jobs table
Source file must never be deleted until the jobs row is committed.
